## Bugs fixed
I reproduced the first two in your original before fixing them.

1. **Reset didn't actually reset.** It cleared saved storage but kept checked subtasks, statuses and notes on screen, then saved them again on your next click. In my test, 1 subtask stayed checked after Reset and came back after the next click.
2. **"Toggle Region" closed the county dropdown.** The list was rebuilt after each click, so the page thought you had clicked outside it. It also cleared any county search you had typed. The list is now built once and only the checkmarks change.
3. **Importing a partial or damaged backup file broke the page.** For example, a file without `selectedCounties` crashed it. Saved and imported data are now checked field by field, and anything invalid falls back to the default.
4. **The sticky phase tabs slid under the header on phones.** They sat 68px from the top, but the header is 173px tall at phone width. They now follow the header's real height.
5. **Timeline week labels didn't line up with the bars.** They were spread evenly instead of placed by week number. Bars also can no longer run past the end of the chart.
6. **Math formatting codes showed as literal text:** `Caseload $\le$ 15` and `$\ge 5\%$`.

## Speed-ups
- **The CDN version of Tailwind is gone.** `cdn.tailwindcss.com` downloads a styling compiler and runs it in the browser on every page load and every screen update; Tailwind says it isn't meant for production. It's replaced with about 27 KB of ready-made CSS inside the file. This also means the page no longer needs that CDN to look right.
- **Less work per click.** Checking a box, changing a status or saving a note no longer rebuilds the county list and regional contact cards. Each full refresh now works out the filtered steps once instead of four or five times, and uses quick lookups instead of repeated searches through the data.
- **Smaller tidy-ups.** The same statewide contact lines were repeated in all six regions and now live in one place. Export builds the download file in a more standard way.

## Accessibility
- **Closing and focus:** pop-ups now close with Escape or a click outside them, and keyboard focus returns to where you were.
- **Screen readers:** pop-ups and notifications are now announced properly.
- **Keyboard:** the subtask text that opens instructions now works from the keyboard.

## One trade-off to know about
Because the styles are now built ahead of time, any **new** Tailwind class you add later won't take effect until you rebuild them. The command is in a comment at the top of the file.
